en: Colorized vintage postcard showing two young women or girls in traditional Dutch clothing, with white caps and shawls and bright red skirts over darker underdresses. One is seated on a stone bench or balustrade while holding an open book, and the other stands beside her, looking at the book. The background shows a path bordered by trees receding into the distance. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption.
